text:
maria: sliding out in ~20m — quick handoff. current state: 1) INC-2026-045 (embed-evictions) still showing elevated eviction rate in eu-west; 2) regen-surge-eu-west: bursty requests causing some tail latency spikes for /v1/regen; 3) kv-cache memory churn on kvcache-prod-3. mitigations applied below.

maria: what I did in the last hour:
- toggled prefix caching to conservative on eu-west prefetcher (rolled config flag).
- scaled down canary for model-x to keep headroom.
- kicked a kvcache GC sweep on prod-3 (manual).

maria: mitigations in place right now:
- embed-evictions: increasing eviction threshold temporarily (config: `embedding.cache.eviction.threshold=0.82`) and enabling async writeback. watch eviction-rate in dashboard.
- regen-surge: routing policy set to fallback to model-x-2 for requests >3s.
- kvcache: GC sweep in progress, monitoring mem RSS.

maria: immediate ask for incoming shift (daniel): please watch for re-appearance of >5% eviction rate for more than 3 consecutive minutes. If seen, rollback prefix-cache change and open INC with pager duty tag.

daniel: got it. watching eviction-rate and will keep an eye on queue depth. can you drop the exact grafana panel link?

maria: sure — https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/embeds/evictions?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west :round_pushpin:

ashley: quick note — i have the PR ready to throttle regen clients with low-priority queue; it's in review (PR #4123). if we need faster rollback path i can patch the routing policy.

riley: autoscaler behavior — saw one node preempt in eu-west-1a ~15m ago. I increased scale margin from 10%->20% for the pool handling regen. monitoring node churn.

theo: logs from the kvcache pod show repeated OOM kill attempts earlier. tail attached:```/var/log/kvcache/kvcache-prod-3.log
[2026-03-17T21:02:11Z] WARNING mem_usage=0.94; evictions=124
[2026-03-17T21:03:02Z] INFO triggered_gc_sweep
```

maria: thanks theo. jamal — can you keep the incident channel open for customer-facing comms? we should draft 1-line status for CS if eviction persists.

jamal: yep i'll draft a short blurb if we reach 10% eviction threshold. ping me with the latest numbers.

opsbot: deploy-bot: canary rollback detected for service=model-x at 2026-03-17T21:05:30Z by maria.

daniel: quick checks I'll run on shift start:
- `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=kvcache -o wide` to check pod restarts
- `curl -sS https://internal-health/regen | jq .latency_p95` for regen p95
- confirm autoscaler events with `gcloud compute instances operations list --filter="zone:(eu-west1)" --limit=5`

riley: I'll keep an eye on autoscaler alerts and CPU sweet spots. will post if scale fails to keep up.

ashley: re: PR #4123 i've added a feature flag so we can enable throttling only for eu-west; should be safe to flip if needed.

daniel: on it. will also validate that fallback model-x-2 is warmed (kv cache present). command to check KV cache hit rate: `curl https://metrics.internal/kvcache?region=eu-west&metric=hit_rate`

maria: known followups for next shift:
- verify GC completed and mem RSS below 60% on kvcache-prod-3.
- confirm no new eviction incidents in past 30m.
- monitor regen p95 and open INC if p95>1.5s for >5min.
- if eviction returns, revert prefix-cache conservative flag and coordinate with ashley for PR throttle.

theo: left a short runbook snippet in the ops-runbooks gist: https://gist.internal/runbooks/kvcache-gc-sweep — includes `kubectl` commands and safe rollback steps.

daniel: acked. I'll take the bridge and check everything in first 10m. tagging oncall rota: @riley @ashley please stay available for 30m in case we need a quick rollback or patch.

riley: here and ready. :eyes:

ashley: available — will monitor PR and can push emergency patch if needed.

jamal: I'll standby for customer comms.

maria: thanks team — handing off now. leaving my contact if needed: pager# +1-650-555-0137. see you all later. :wave:
